# Expensify

Spend, expenses and bills · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Expensify publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Expensify's own Claude plugin (Expensify/expensify-plugin) has two read-only skills, both indexed: a spend brief and a flux analysis. They run on Expensify's hosted server, which is also read-only.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://www.expensify.com/mcp** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Expensify account. Read-only.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Expensify

- **[Expensify flux analysis](../../skills/expensify-flux-analysis/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Expensify's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/Expensify/expensify-plugin/tree/main/skills/flux-analysis)
  Expensify's own skill comparing spend across two periods, naming the biggest movers by category and vendor.
- **[Expensify spend brief](../../skills/expensify-spend-brief/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Expensify's MCP server, signed in · [source](https://github.com/Expensify/expensify-plugin/tree/main/skills/spend-brief)
  Expensify's own skill for a plain-English spend summary for a period: totals by category, person and vendor, with anomalies flagged.
